overview_description.description:
End Game Interactive is a game development company that built third-party apps for games such as Pokévision. End Game Interactive is a developer of ZombsRoyale.io, a real-time multiplayer shooter that runs in browsers across numerous platforms.

It was founded in 2019 and headquartered in Bellevue, Washington.
